Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Post Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Post Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 80,000/- per month for the Post Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Computer Science or Mathematics, with specific research experience and publications as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you follow the application instructions carefully and send your application before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Post Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Post Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Post Doctoral Fellow position is a contractual role.
